text: Find the oldest object in this room.
hint: Ask, if you are not sure.

text: Listen for the quietest sound you can hear.
Count the different textures within arm’s reach.
Notice what colour the light is right now.
Find something in this room that was made by hand.
Watch one person’s hands for a minute.
Name three smells, in order of strength.
Find the thing in this room that has travelled furthest.
Notice where the shadows fall, and which way they are moving.
Find something that is slightly broken and still loved.
Listen for the rhythm of the room: the sounds that repeat.
Find the warmest spot you can reach without standing up.
Notice what everyone is doing with their feet.
Find a word written somewhere here that was never meant to be read.
Spot the newest thing in the room.
Notice which way people lean when they laugh.
Find something here that will not exist in a hundred years.
Find something here that will.
Watch the steam, the smoke or the dust, and see where it goes.
Notice the sound of your own breathing.
Find the most carefully placed object in the room.
Find the most carelessly placed one.
Look at the ceiling for thirty seconds.
Find a repair someone made that you had never noticed.
Notice the temperature of the thing in your hand.
Find three different shades of the same colour.
Listen to a conversation you are not part of, without judging it.
Find something here that is about the same age as you.
Notice what the person opposite does with their eyes when they think.
Find the object in the room with the longest story.
Notice how the floor feels through your shoes.
Find a shape that appears more than five times in this room.
Guess how many people have sat in your seat before you.
Find something that was once alive.
Notice what you can hear from outside.
Find the darkest corner and the brightest surface.
Watch someone eat or drink, and notice their ritual.
Find something that has been mended, patched or taped.
Notice which way the air is moving.
hint: Wet a finger if you must.

text: Find the most expensive thing here that nobody looks at.
Find the cheapest thing here that everyone uses.
Look at your own hands as if they belonged to a stranger.
Notice the way the person next to you says your name.
Find a plant and decide by touch whether it is real.
Listen for a sound that stops, and notice the silence it leaves.
Find a line that is perfectly straight, and one that only pretends to be.
Notice what the youngest person here is paying attention to.
Find the one thing you would carry out if the building were on fire.
Notice a smell that belongs to this place and nowhere else.
Find a reflection you had not noticed before.
Notice what happens to the room when someone leaves it.
Find the object here that has been touched the most.
Look out of the nearest window until something moves.
Count the different typefaces you can see without turning your head.
Find something that is slowly changing while you watch.
Notice the weight of your own head.
Listen for the furthest sound you can hear.
Find something here that somebody chose with care.
Notice the one thing in this room you would miss most.
Close your eyes for one minute, then open them and find what has changed.
